routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area

data_model.viewMode: client-side per-page-load state: 'grid' (default on load) | 'list'; not persisted

notes: REQ-5.2: the notes page opens in grid view by default when the home page first loads. The home page (GET /) renders with the notes area in grid layout (state.listView = false, no body.list-view class), so the notes containers use the default .notes-grid masonry layout and the toolbar shows the list-view toggle (the single icon button whose accessible name is 'List view', the view you switch TO from grid mode). The list-view toggle button is present in the served HTML on first load (REQ-1.1 header) and stays visible/enabled at all times; it is a real <button> carrying the exact accessible name. View mode is per-page-load client state only (REQ-5.1 already wired the toggle: clicking 'List view' switches to a stacked list layout and renames the button 'Grid view'; clicking again restores grid). No backend/route/data changes and no persistence: on every fresh page load the page opens in grid view with the toolbar showing the 'List view' toggle, exactly as the scenario requires. Existing features (search, filters, sections, note actions) are untouched.
